messages.マイナス効果の多い敵にS2「血描画」を当て、確率のコイン再使用で出血回数を一気に: A Ring Identity that uses S2 Sanguine Painting against enemies with many negative effects, rapidly adding Bleed Count through probabilistic Coin reuse. Prepares enemies for allies that rely on Bleed Count in Ring or Bleed teams.
messages.S2「血描画」: 対象の出血6以上でマッチ威力+2(低い同期化段階では+1)。Ⅱ: **S2 — Sanguine Painting**: +2 Clash Power if the target has at least 6 Bleed (+1 at lower Uptie). On Coin Ⅱ hit, reuses the Coin with a chance of 40% (20% at lower Uptie) plus 20% per negative effect on the target (up to 2 times per skill). Each hit adds +1 Bleed Count, and +1 more when reused by her own Coin effect.
messages.マイナス効果を増やす: バトルパッシブ「点々」(色欲×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): **Adding negative effects**: Through the combat passive Multitude of Dots (4 Lust Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), at Combat Start, she inflicts 2 of a random one of Burn, Bleed, Tremor, Rupture, or Sinking on the 2 enemies with the fewest negative effects (1 at lower Uptie). Coin Ⅱ of S3 Artwork Inspection also inflicts 3 Bleed and 3 of a random one.
messages.S3「作品精査」: 対象のマイナス効果1つにつきダメージ量+12.5%(最大50: **S3 — Artwork Inspection**: +12.5% damage per negative effect on the target (up to 50%; 10%, up to 30%, at lower Uptie). On use, gives 1 Haste next turn to the allies on both sides of her on the dashboard. If the target is staggered or dead after the attack, gives 1 Pierce DMG Up next turn to the 1 ally with the highest SP other than herself.
messages.出血人格扱い: パッシブ「血点描派」により、ランダムで状態異常を付与するスキルが: **Treated as a Bleed Identity**: Through the passive Sanguine Pointillist, she is treated only as a Bleed-inflicting Identity, even though she has skills that inflict random status effects.
messages.S1「点を打つ」: 2コインで、表面的中時に出血1ずつ。対象の出血6以上でマッチ: **S1 — Dotting**: 2 Coins, each inflicting 1 Bleed on Heads Hit. +1 Clash Power if the target has at least 6 Bleed, and +1 Coin Power at 10 or more.
messages.「点々」とS3のランダム付与で敵のマイナス効果の種類を増やしてから、S2を当てて: Increase the types of negative effects on enemies with Multitude of Dots and S3's random infliction, then land S2 to raise its reuse chance and extend Bleed Count. S2's Bleed Count increase caps at +5 (+1 on Coin Ⅱ hit and +2 on each reuse hit, up to 2), and Bleed Count drops by 1 with each Coin check, so S2 alone may not reach 6. It is used to add on top of existing Bleed Count. She cannot inflict much Bleed Potency herself either, so pair her with allies who stack Bleed. Yi Sang's The Ring Pointillist Student has S2 Sanguine Pointillism and S3 Hematic Coloring, which gain +1 Coin Power per 3 Bleed Count on the target (up to 2), so her groundwork of extending Bleed Count fits well. Treat S3 as a way to hand out Haste and Pierce DMG Up to allies. Her Clash strength and durability are lowish, so she is safest used as a keyword member in Ring and Bleed teams.
